title: pimpinella hiernii
intro: Pimpinella hiernii, commonly known as the Chinese burnet, is a plant species within the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Pimpinella hiernii include its vasodilatory, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
